title: Date Night Takes A Horrible Turn For The Worse
description:
#news #police #arrest

On April 4th, 2022. Officers tried to conduct a traffic stop on a vehicle because of illegal window tints. When the officer pulled up to the vehicle, the suspect rolled his window down and immediately fled from the officers. During the chase, the suspect dropped off a lady that he was on a date with on the side of the road and took off again. Officers continue to chase the suspect to an apartment complex in which his “Baby mama” lived. He then crashed the car into a fence and tried running on foot. 

When officers tried to ask for his last name, he said "I don't know". He eventually answered the question and he said his name was "Shamar Richardson". When officers ran a check on the name, nothing was found leading to further investigation. He eventually gave up his real name and turned out he had 4 outstanding warrants with a bond of $70,000.
